subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about re-activating your lapsed riders for {Brand}. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to a confirmed completed ride, the booking carrying a ride-ID and fare value that survives the cancellation window, so you pay only for validated, cancellation-adjusted trips rather than app opens or clicks. At scale we hold around 9,000 completed rides a day from retargeting campaigns (illustrative). If it helps, I can send the city-level segment breakdown for your market. Open to a quick look?
illustrative_flags: 9,000 completed rides a day from retargeting campaigns (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ride_hailing retargeting (Australia): references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof point (optimize to confirmed completed ride, ride-ID + fare value, cancellation-adjusted payout); one illustrative MobUpps figure flagged (9,000 completed rides/day); soft CTA with exactly one question mark; {Brand} and RECIPIENT_NAME tokens kept; no sign-off; no em-dash; differentiator stated positively with no 'X, not Y'; native business register.
